notes: Pick which Ervo is your home-screen icon, Personal or Business, with a switch in Ervo's Look. The icon changes quietly once you leave the app, no more getting kicked out
Ervo's Look scrolls without closing; a quick "Switching to Business" curtain when you change Ervos
Work settings show only for Business; the owner can create co-owner IDs; IDs are longer and never reused
Smoother: fewer heavy effects while you move around the app
23 looks for Ervo: Royal, Detective, Explorer, Scientist, Wizard, Ninja, Samurai, Pirate, Pilot, Athlete, Soccer, Musician, Chef, Artist, Holiday and more, all cut out clean
Your home-screen icon follows Ervo's look. On iPhone, the icon you add to the home screen uses the look you had picked
Ervo for Business thinks like a business: Ideas are about customers, billing, taxes, suppliers, team and renewals, shaped by what your company does. No dentist appointments here
Business Psyche: what Ervo learns in Business is about the company (products, policies, customers, finance, tools, schedule, team), kept apart from your personal Psyche
Co-owners: the owner can make an employee a co-owner, with everything the owner can do except removing co-owners or the owner
An employee whose access was removed sees why when they open Ervo, and can rejoin with a new ID
How Ervo Works reads differently in Business; Reset asks twice; the Switch row sits at the top of Settings
